discourse.title: When women are honoured
discourse.excerpt: The Veda declares that where women are honoured and esteemed, there divinity is present with all its potency.
discourse.theme: Honouring women is not courtesy alone — where women are honoured and esteemed, divinity is present with all its potency.

reflection: Swami roots honour for women in scripture, not sentiment: the home and the community where women are esteemed is where divinity dwells in full potency. Today, honour one woman in your life concretely — thank your mother, wife, sister or teacher by name for something specific she has done for you. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28, 19 Nov 1995)

video.title: Sacred Titles of Women - Sathya Sai Discourse

seva_nudge: Thank a woman who serves your family or community — a mother, teacher or volunteer — with a specific, heartfelt word of appreciation today.
